name: Utility
description: Some specific dialogs for utility entities.

lines.name: Road Sign
lines.text: AAAB Village. Straight ahead, along the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: No name. No direction. No promise of what lies further down the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: I found a key in the chestbox. I wonder what it's for. It's probably for some other chestbox.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Inside the chest, you discover old books and records of the Warriors’ Guild that once occupied this house.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Among the texts, you manage to find the name of the northeastern house — “assembly-hall.”

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You have found the sword the guardsman spoke of. Its steel is engraved with ancient runes. You should deliver it to its rightful master.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You don't have the key to the chestbox. You need to find it first.

lines.name: Voice of Reason
lines.text: You look at the path you’ve left behind. You have just come from there, and many experiences await you ahead.

lines.name: Voice of Reason
lines.text: It is not yet time to leave.
